BUILT 2026-11-18 behind CALENDAR_SYNC_ENABLED (owner ruling the same day: build it behind an off switch now, credentials later; ADR-1976). Google Calendar has a real Connect button for a Space owner or admin when the switch is on and GOOGLE_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID / _SECRET and CALENDAR_SYNC_ENCRYPTION_KEY are set: OAuth with PKCE and a one-use state (app/api/integrations/calendar/[provider]/callback), tokens sealed with AES-256-GCM bound to Space, provider and connection (lib/calendar-sync/seal.ts), Sync now, Disconnect, and a conflicts list. A sync pushes published events (pushed copies carry the event id and a fingerprint as private properties, marked free) and mirrors busy time back as Busy Unavailable entries on the private layer. Conflict rule in lib/calendar-sync/plan.ts with tests: Frequency wins for its own events, but a copy edited in Google is listed, not overwritten, until the team picks Use Frequency's version or Keep their edit. Apple and Notion rows explain the honest path (the feed; Notion Calendar reads Google). Outlook is not built: its row says so. NOT LIVE YET: migration 20270346100000_calendar_sync_connections.sql is written and NOT applied; the switch is off; the Google client needs the Calendar API, the calendar.events scope and the redirect URI /api/integrations/calendar/google/callback. Sync runs on demand only (no cron). Activation gate: docs/RUNBOOKS.md Calendar sync.

Closed 2026-11-18: the probe passes because the sync rows no longer carry the Coming soon mark; Google has a working connect path behind CALENDAR_SYNC_ENABLED, which stays off until the gate in docs/RUNBOOKS.md Calendar sync is met.
